messages.text: BL-1877 🎵 in progress — Every role's pre-commit hook runs the whole property lane (493 files, about 7 minutes) when a commit stages any extension/src file or property test; 41 commits paid it on 2026-10-01 alone, and QA's gather runs the same lane once per parcel anyway; a commit now runs only the property files its staged change reaches, and the whole lane only when it cannot tell which
